1485. Minimum File Merge Cost

40

Medium

Problem Statement:
Given n files, each with a certain size, you need to merge all the files into one. The cost of each merge is the sum of the sizes of the two files being merged. After a merge, the two files are replaced by a single file of their combined size. The goal is to find the minimum cost required to merge all the files into one file.
input_spec: The first input is an integer whose name is n which means number of files. The second input is a list of n integers which represents the size of each file.
output_spec: Print a single integer representing the minimum cost to merge all files into one file.
